components.css: :host{--cosmos-blue-2:#f3f8fc;--cosmos-blue-3:#e7f1f8;--cosmos-blue-4:#d9e9f3;--cosmos-blue-7:#8fb8d3;--cosmos-blue-9:#005274;--cosmos-blue-10:#0e6e9e;--cosmos-blue-11:#135f85;--cosmos-blue-12:#0f2c3b;--cosmos-text-muted:#5b6770}.ds-card{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,3fr);max-width:560px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--cosmos-blue-4);border-radius:.75rem;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;font-family:'Open Sans',sans-serif}.ds-card:hover{border-color:var(--cosmos-blue-7);box-shadow:0 6px 18px -8px rgba(15,44,59,.25)}.ds-card:has(a:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--cosmos-blue-9);outline-offset:2px}.ds-card a:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-card-media{background:var(--cosmos-blue-2);border-right:1px solid var(--cosmos-blue-3);transition:background-color .2s ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-media{background:var(--cosmos-blue-3)}.ds-card-initial{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:1;font-family:Raleway,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:4.5rem;color:var(--cosmos-blue-7)}.ds-card-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:1.25rem 1.25rem 1.375rem}.ds-card-body h2{margin:0 0 .5rem;font-family:Raleway,sans-serif;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800}.ds-card-link{color:var(--cosmos-blue-12);text-decoration:none}.ds-card-link::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0}.ds-card-body p{margin:0 0 1.25rem;font-size:.975rem;line-height:1.6;color:var(--cosmos-text-muted)}.ds-card-more{margin-top:auto;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--cosmos-blue-11)}.ds-card-more svg{transition:transform .2s ease}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-more{color:var(--cosmos-blue-10)}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-more svg{transform:translateX(3px)}

narrative.overview:
The site works like a well-kept association notice board: everything has its own card, cards are easy to scan, and a visitor finds their committee, event or document without reading the whole page. It is friendly and orderly rather than flashy. Cosmos blue does the branding; the layout stays calm and predictable so the content (committees, events, photos, people) carries the personality.

Density is moderate: generous space around each card, compact text inside it. Pages lead with a plain heading and one sentence of context, then go straight into the content. Decoration is limited to the blue scale and one soft fade under the navbar on detail pages.
keyCharacteristics: One brand colour, Cosmos blue, used as a 12-step scale for every tint, border and text shade.
Raleway (extra bold) for headings, Open Sans for everything else.
Flat cards with a thin pale-blue border; depth only appears on hover.
The whole card is the link; navigation is text links, buttons are for actions.
Left-aligned page headers with an intro line, not centred titles.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Every colour on a page comes from the blue scale or the two greys. No other hues, and no raw hex values in templates or page CSS; use the `--cosmos-blue-*` variables.

rules.name: The Step Rule
rules.body: Steps 1–2 are backgrounds, 3–5 fills, 6–8 borders, 9–10 solid colour, 11–12 text. If a colour is doing a job outside its step range, pick another step.

rules.name: The Real Heading Rule
rules.body: Use heading levels for structure, not size: one `h1` per page, `h2` for cards or sections. Size comes from the role above, never from picking `h5` because it looks right.

rules.name: The No Global Paragraph Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs are 1rem with no top margin. The old site-wide rule (`p { margin-top: 2em; font-size: 18px }`) is legacy; new components must not depend on it and it will be removed.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing has a shadow until the pointer is on it. The older always-on card shadow (`0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.06)`) and the lift-on-hover (`translateY(-4px)`) are legacy.

dos: **Do** take every colour from `--cosmos-blue-1` to `--cosmos-blue-12`, `--black` (body text; the global-fixes PR renames it `--cosmos-text`) or `--cosmos-text-muted`.
**Do** make the whole card the click target with one stretched title link.
**Do** give every list an empty state written as a plain sentence ("No committees to show yet.").
**Do** use square images in cards, and the initial fallback when there's no image.
**Do** check new pages at 390px, 768px and 1280px wide.
donts: **Don't** use Bootstrap's default blue (`#0d6efd`), `--light-blue` or `#124265`; they're replaced by the scale.
**Don't** add shadows at rest, translate cards on hover, or add gradients other than the navbar fade on detail pages.
**Don't** centre page titles or set section titles in all caps.
**Don't** add new fonts or font weights beyond Raleway 700/800 and Open Sans 400/600.
